To give you more context @Haroenv:
 - isRefined used first helps the user not loosing facet values that were selected but are not very important for the current search context
 - we went along on all connectors that were proposing sortBy
 - forgot to proceed on widgets
 - and this change also brings the default scheme meaningful for the type of widget: hierarchical need and menu need name first because they are for navigation (few items). Refinement list is for drilling in the data (more facets)
